subject: Hanlin iPad message selection and preview
scope: User item 3: bounded message preview and stable presentation ownership
User item 4: continuous native text selection and deliberate longer-hold preview
Regression protection for attributed streaming updates and exact saved-source coordinates

portable_preview_viewport.qualification: The viewport compilation and fixture independently exited 0 after the earlier native edit-plan fixture failed in the same diagnostic job. The job as a whole was not successful.

swift_syntax.initial_scope: 13 renderer Swift files and 6 app Swift files
swift_syntax.initial_qualification: Both parse invocations emitted exit=0 before the 15-second job timeout. The timeout supplies no completed result for the subsequent compilation/fixture stage.
swift_syntax.qualification: Windows swiftc -frontend -parse only; this is not Apple SDK type checking or UIKit execution.

whitespace.qualification: Both exited 0. Git emitted CRLF conversion warnings in the renderer worktree; no whitespace errors.

superseded_failure.finding: For CR followed by an appended LF, NSString.rangeOfComposedCharacterSequence returned a boundary between CR and LF on this Foundation runtime. The changed tail must not split that line-break grapheme.
superseded_failure.production_correction: NativeTextEditPlan now explicitly moves a CR/LF boundary back one UTF-16 unit in both the old and new canonical source strings.
regressions_retained: Attribute change on LF inside CRLF
Combining marks, ZWJ family, emoji skin tone, stable cross-paragraph selection, attribute-only changes, 100 appends to a 200-paragraph RTL/emoji document
superseded_failure.qualification: The failing jobs are retained as failures, not relabeled as successful validation.

validation_limits.claim: These results verify portable Foundation edit/viewport logic and source syntax. They do not establish native layout, gesture arbitration, selection dragging, accessibility behavior, frame rate, or crash freedom on iPad. Native archive and physical iPad acceptance remain separate evidence.

implementation_contract.selection_guard: Reject preview when native selection already exists at touch-down; movement/handle dragging keeps selection ownership.
implementation_contract.preview_geometry: Bounded preferredContentSize with content filling actual UIKit host bounds; explicit locale, layout direction, color scheme, Dynamic Type and citation environment.
implementation_contract.streaming_update: Canonical previous attributes are compared before native textStorage tail replacement; animated/highlight-mutated textStorage is not the comparison source.
implementation_contract.source_coordinates: Existing hanlin-part: IDs remain exact. Full-document captures use hanlin-message: and reopen the same full-document surface.
implementation_contract.rich_content: Ordinary rich block renderers remain; contiguous prose shares native selection, and Select Text provides a single attributed document across block boundaries.

source_hash_capture.qualification: Hashes were captured from current final source files after validation. Byte hashes reflect actual worktree line endings; LF-normalized hashes are provided for cross-checkout comparison. Earlier failing jobs used the pre-correction helper and do not have these final hashes.
